X Square releases X2Real evaluation tools spanning 44 robot tasks

The Isaac Lab-Arena benchmark links simulated scores to hardware tests while defining limits of its public release.

Humanoids Daily ↗19 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 1

A public tool for comparing models

X Square announced X2Real on October 19. The research benchmark spans 44 tasks and ten capability dimensions, including language understanding, tool use and bimanual coordination. The new development here is the public-tool announcement; the technical report was published earlier.

Correlation is not a success percentage

The report compares WALL-OSS-0.5 on eight physical and simulated tasks. It reports correlations of 0.84 for task progress and 0.74 for success rates. A correlation of 0.84 does not mean 84% task success, and precision tasks still reveal differences between the two environments.

Understand the downloadable scope

The public evaluator contains 73 in-distribution cases, configurations rather than 73 new tasks, and separates evaluation from the model service. Its scope document excludes training, out-of-distribution definitions and several automatic data-generation tools. Developers must distinguish the complete research system from the public package and continue to test on physical hardware.
